# MLP Implementation with Training Visualization


```{r load_libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(recipes)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r model_implementation}
# Function to preprocess data without causing leakage
preprocess_data <- function(df, target_col, recipe_obj = NULL, is_training = TRUE) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
  
  if (is_training) {
    recipe_obj <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")), data = df) %>%
      step_zv(all_predictors()) %>% 
      step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
      step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) %>%
      prep(training = df)  # Prepare using training data only
  }
  
  processed_df <- bake(recipe_obj, new_data = df)  # Apply transformations
  target <- processed_df[[target_col]]
  predictors <- processed_df %>% select(-all_of(target_col))
  
  list(x = as.matrix(predictors), y = as.numeric(target), recipe_obj = recipe_obj)
}


initialize_parameters <- function(input_size, hidden_size1, hidden_size2, output_size = 1) {
  if (is.na(input_size) || is.na(hidden_size1) || is.na(hidden_size2) || is.na(output_size)) {
    stop("Invalid dimensions passed to initialize_parameters.")
  }
  list(
    W1 = matrix(runif(input_size * hidden_size1, -0.5, 0.5), nrow = input_size, ncol = hidden_size1),
    b1 = runif(hidden_size1, -0.5, 0.5),
    W2 = matrix(runif(hidden_size1 * hidden_size2, -0.5, 0.5), nrow = hidden_size1, ncol = hidden_size2),
    b2 = runif(hidden_size2, -0.5, 0.5),
    W3 = matrix(runif(hidden_size2 * output_size, -0.5, 0.5), nrow = hidden_size2, ncol = output_size),
    b3 = runif(output_size, -0.5, 0.5)
  )
}

leaky_relu <- function(x, alpha = 0.01) {
  pmax(alpha * x, x)
}

# Batch normalization function
batch_normalize <- function(x) {
  mean_x <- colMeans(x)
  std_x <- apply(x, 2, sd)
  (x - mean_x) / (std_x + 1e-8) # Normalize with small epsilon to avoid division by zero
}

forward_propagation <- function(x, params) {

  # First hidden layer
  z1 <- x %*% params$W1 + matrix(params$b1, nrow = nrow(x), ncol = length(params$b1), byrow = TRUE) # nolint: line_length_linter. # nolint
  a1 <- leaky_relu(z1)
   # nolint
  # Second hidden layer
  z2 <- a1 %*% params$W2 + matrix(params$b2, nrow = nrow(a1), ncol = length(params$b2), byrow = TRUE)
  a2 <- leaky_relu(z2)
  
  # Output layer
  z3 <- a2 %*% params$W3 + matrix(params$b3, nrow = nrow(a2), ncol = length(params$b3), byrow = TRUE)
  
  list(a1 = a1, a2 = a2, z3 = z3)
}

# Mean squared error (MSE) loss function
mse_loss <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  mean((y_pred - y_true)^2) # Compute average squared error between predictions and actual values
}

# Mean absolute error (MAE) function
mae_loss <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  mean(abs(y_pred - y_true)) # Compute average absolute error
}

# Root mean squared error (RMSE) function
rmse_loss <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  sqrt(mean((y_pred - y_true)^2)) # Compute RMSE
}

# R-squared (R²) Score function
r2_score <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  ss_total <- sum((y_true - mean(y_true))^2)
  ss_residual <- sum((y_true - y_pred)^2)
  1 - (ss_residual / ss_total) # Compute R² Score
}

# Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE)
mape_loss <- function(y_pred, y_true) {
  # Add a small constant to avoid division by zero
  epsilon <- 1e-8

  # Exclude cases where y_true is too small
  valid_indices <- y_true > epsilon
  if (sum(valid_indices) == 0) {
    warning("All true values are too small for MAPE calculation.")
    return(NA)
  }

  mean(abs((y_true[valid_indices] - y_pred[valid_indices]) / (y_true[valid_indices] + epsilon))) * 100
}

# Modified train_mlp_manual function to track metrics across epochs
train_mlp_manual <- function(df, target_col, hidden_size = 32, epochs = 5000, learning_rate = 0.02, test_split = 0.2, lambda = 0.01) {
  # Preprocess dataset
  data <- preprocess_data(df, target_col)
  x <- data$x # Extract feature matrix
  y <- data$y # Extract target variable

  # Split into training and testing sets
  set.seed(123)
  train_indices <- sample(1:nrow(x), size = floor((1 - test_split) * nrow(x)))
  train_data <- df[train_indices, ]
  test_data <- df[-train_indices, ]

  # Preprocess training data
  train_processed <- preprocess_data(train_data, target_col)
  x_train <- train_processed$x
  y_train <- train_processed$y
  recipe_obj <- train_processed$recipe_obj

  # Preprocess testing data using the same recipe
  test_processed <- preprocess_data(test_data, target_col, recipe_obj)
  x_test <- test_processed$x
  y_test <- test_processed$y

  input_size <- ncol(x_train) # Number of input features
  output_size <- 1 # Output is a single scalar (area)
  
  # Initialize model parameters (weights and biases)
  params <- initialize_parameters(input_size, hidden_size, hidden_size, output_size)

  # Track metrics across epochs for plotting
  metrics <- data.frame(
    epoch = integer(),
    train_loss = numeric(),
    test_loss = numeric(),
    train_r2 = numeric(),
    test_r2 = numeric()
  )
  
  for (epoch in 1:epochs) {
    # Forward pass for training
    forward_train <- forward_propagation(x_train, params)
    y_pred_train <- forward_train$z3 # Predicted values for training set
    y_pred_train <- as.matrix(y_pred_train) # Ensure correct dimensions
    
    # Forward pass for testing
    forward_test <- forward_propagation(x_test, params)
    y_pred_test <- forward_test$z3
    y_pred_test <- as.matrix(y_pred_test)
    
    # Compute metrics
    train_loss <- mse_loss(y_pred_train, y_train)
    test_loss <- mse_loss(y_pred_test, y_test)
    train_r2 <- r2_score(y_pred_train, y_train)
    test_r2 <- r2_score(y_pred_test, y_test)
    
    # Record metrics every 100 epochs or at specific points
    if (epoch == 1 || epoch %% 100 == 0 || epoch == epochs) {
      metrics <- rbind(metrics, data.frame(
        epoch = epoch,
        train_loss = train_loss,
        test_loss = test_loss,
        train_r2 = train_r2,
        test_r2 = test_r2
      ))
      
      # Print progress
      if (epoch %% 500 == 0) {
        cat(sprintf("Epoch %d: Train Loss = %.6f, Test Loss = %.6f, Train R² = %.4f, Test R² = %.4f\n", 
                  epoch, train_loss, test_loss, train_r2, test_r2))
      }
    }

    # Backward pass (compute gradients)
    dL_dz3 <- 2 * (y_pred_train - y_train) / length(y_train) # Gradient of loss w.r.t. output layer
    dL_dz3 <- dL_dz3 * (y_pred_train > 0)
    dL_dW3 <- t(forward_train$a2) %*% dL_dz3 + lambda * params$W3 # Gradient of weights in output layer
    dL_db3 <- colSums(dL_dz3) # Gradient of biases in output layer
    
    dL_da2 <- dL_dz3 %*% t(params$W3) # Gradient w.r.t. activations of second hidden layer
    dL_dz2 <- dL_da2 * (forward_train$a2 > 0) # Apply Leaky ReLU derivative
    dL_dW2 <- t(forward_train$a1) %*% dL_dz2 + lambda * params$W2 # Gradient of weights in second hidden layer
    dL_db2 <- colSums(dL_dz2) # Gradient of biases in second hidden layer
    
    dL_da1 <- dL_dz2 %*% t(params$W2) # Gradient w.r.t. activations of first hidden layer
    dL_dz1 <- dL_da1 * (forward_train$a1 > 0) # Apply Leaky ReLU derivative
    dL_dW1 <- t(x_train) %*% dL_dz1 + lambda * params$W1 # Gradient of weights in first hidden layer
    dL_db1 <- colSums(dL_dz1) # Gradient of biases in first hidden layer

    # Gradient descent updates
    params$W1 <- params$W1 - learning_rate * dL_dW1
    params$b1 <- params$b1 - learning_rate * dL_db1
    params$W2 <- params$W2 - learning_rate * dL_dW2
    params$b2 <- params$b2 - learning_rate * dL_db2
    params$W3 <- params$W3 - learning_rate * dL_dW3
    params$b3 <- params$b3 - learning_rate * dL_db3
  }

  list(params = params, metrics = metrics) # Return trained parameters and metrics history
}

# Function to plot metrics over epochs
plot_training_metrics <- function(metrics) {
  
  # Plot loss over epochs
  loss_plot <- ggplot(metrics, aes(x = epoch)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = train_loss, color = "Training Loss")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = test_loss, color = "Testing Loss")) +
    scale_x_log10() +  # Log scale for better visualization
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Training Loss" = "blue", "Testing Loss" = "red")) +
    labs(title = "Loss over Training Epochs",
         x = "Epoch (log scale)",
         y = "Mean Squared Error",
         color = "Legend") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Plot R² over epochs
  r2_plot <- ggplot(metrics, aes(x = epoch)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = train_r2, color = "Training R²")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = test_r2, color = "Testing R²")) +
    scale_x_log10() +  # Log scale for better visualization
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Training R²" = "green", "Testing R²" = "purple")) +
    labs(title = "R² Score over Training Epochs",
         x = "Epoch (log scale)",
         y = "R² Score",
         color = "Legend") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Return list of plots
  list(loss_plot = loss_plot, r2_plot = r2_plot)
}

# Modified cross-validation function to include plotting
cross_validate_mlp <- function(df, target_col, hidden_size = 32, epochs = 5000, learning_rate = 0.02, lambda = 0.01, k = 5, plot_metrics = TRUE) {
  set.seed(123)  # Ensure reproducibility
  folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = nrow(df)))
  metrics_summary <- data.frame(Fold = integer(), Train_Loss = numeric(), Test_Loss = numeric(), R2 = numeric())
  
  # Store metrics for each fold
  all_metrics <- list()
  
  for (fold in 1:k) {
    train_data <- df[folds != fold, ]
    test_data <- df[folds == fold, ]
    
    # Preprocess training data only and use the same transformation for test data
    train_processed <- preprocess_data(train_data, target_col, is_training = TRUE)
    recipe_obj <- train_processed$recipe_obj
    test_processed <- preprocess_data(test_data, target_col, recipe_obj, is_training = FALSE)
    
    x_train <- train_processed$x
    y_train <- train_processed$y
    x_test <- test_processed$x
    y_test <- test_processed$y
    
    if (ncol(x_train) != ncol(x_test)) {
      stop("Feature mismatch: Training and testing sets have different numbers of features!")
    }
    
    # Train model on the fold
    result <- train_mlp_manual(train_data, target_col, hidden_size, epochs, learning_rate, test_split = 0.2, lambda)
    params <- result$params
    fold_metrics <- result$metrics
    
    # Store metrics for this fold
    all_metrics[[fold]] <- fold_metrics
    
    # Get final metrics
    final_metrics <- fold_metrics[nrow(fold_metrics), ]
    
    metrics_summary <- rbind(metrics_summary, data.frame(
      Fold = fold, 
      Train_Loss = final_metrics$train_loss, 
      Test_Loss = final_metrics$test_loss, 
      R2 = final_metrics$test_r2
    ))
    
    print(paste("Fold", fold, "completed. Train Loss:", round(final_metrics$train_loss, 6), 
                "Test Loss:", round(final_metrics$test_loss, 6), 
                "R² Score:", round(final_metrics$test_r2, 4)))
    
    # Plot metrics 
    if (plot_metrics) {
      plots <- plot_training_metrics(fold_metrics)
      print(plots$loss_plot + ggtitle(paste("Fold", fold, "- Loss over Training Epochs")))
      print(plots$r2_plot + ggtitle(paste("Fold", fold, "- R² Score over Training Epochs")))
    }
  }
  
  # Return detailed metrics and summary
  list(metrics_summary = metrics_summary, all_metrics = all_metrics)
}
```

## Implementation

```{r run_model}
# Load dataset
df <- read.csv("data/forestfires.csv") 
# Convert categorical columns to factors
df$month <- as.factor(df$month)
df$day <- as.factor(df$day)
# Apply log(1 + x) transformation
df$area <- log1p(df$area)

cv_results <- cross_validate_mlp(df, "area", 10000, 0.05, plot_metrics = TRUE)

# Print summary metrics across folds
print(cv_results$metrics_summary)

# Calculate average metrics across folds
cat("\nAverage Metrics Across All Folds:\n")
avg_metrics <- colMeans(cv_results$metrics_summary[, c("Train_Loss", "Test_Loss", "R2")])
print(avg_metrics)
```

## Individual Model Training with Metrics Visualization

```{r single_model}
# Train a single model and visualize metrics
model_result <- train_mlp_manual(
  df = df, 
  target_col = "area", 
  hidden_size = 32,
  epochs = 3000, 
  learning_rate = 0.02,
  test_split = 0.2,
  lambda = 0.05
)

# Plot the training metrics
plots <- plot_training_metrics(model_result$metrics)
print(plots$loss_plot)
print(plots$r2_plot)

# Make predictions using the trained model
test_indices <- sample(1:nrow(df), size = 0.2 * nrow(df))
test_data <- df[test_indices, ]
train_processed <- preprocess_data(df[-test_indices, ], "area")
recipe_obj <- train_processed$recipe_obj
test_processed <- preprocess_data(test_data, "area", recipe_obj, is_training = FALSE)

# Make predictions
predictions <- forward_propagation(test_processed$x, model_result$params)$z3

# Calculate final test metrics
final_mse <- mse_loss(predictions, test_processed$y)
final_r2 <- r2_score(predictions, test_processed$y)
final_rmse <- rmse_loss(predictions, test_processed$y)

cat(sprintf("\nFinal Test Metrics:\nMSE: %.6f\nRMSE: %.6f\nR²: %.4f\n", 
            final_mse, final_rmse, final_r2))

# Plot actual vs predicted values
prediction_df <- data.frame(
  Actual = expm1(test_processed$y),  # Reverse log1p transformation
  Predicted = expm1(predictions)      # Reverse log1p transformation
)

ggplot(prediction_df, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Actual vs Predicted Values",
       x = "Actual Area (Original Scale)",
       y = "Predicted Area (Original Scale)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
